nodes.title: Implement core logic for kernel computation using relator lifts
nodes.description: Implement the mathematical core for computing the kernel of a surjective homomorphism between FpGroups. For a surjective homomorphism φ: G → H where G and H are FpGroups, the kernel is generated by lifts of H's relators. The implementation should: (1) Iterate through the relators of the codomain FpGroup, (2) Use the `invert` method to compute the lift (preimage) of each relator in the domain, (3) Collect these lifts as generators for the kernel, (4) Return an FpSubgroup generated by these lifts with normal=True. This approach works for both finite and infinite groups since it doesn't require computing orders.
nodes.expected_output: The core algorithm logic as Python code that computes kernel generators from relator lifts, suitable for integration into the _compute_kernel method.

nodes.title: Integrate relator-lift approach into _compute_kernel method
nodes.description: Modify the `_compute_kernel` method in the `GroupHomomorphism` class to use the relator-lift approach for FpGroup to FpGroup/FreeGroup homomorphisms. The implementation should: (1) Add a new branch at the beginning of `_compute_kernel` to check if both domain and codomain are FpGroup or FreeGroup instances, (2) Check surjectivity using `is_surjective()` method - if True or None (unknown for infinite groups), use the relator-lift approach, (3) Handle FreeGroup codomain which has no relators (empty generator list), (4) For non-surjective homomorphisms of finite groups, fall through to existing permutation group conversion approach, (5) Ensure the existing code paths for PermutationGroup domains and non-surjective finite FpGroups remain functional.
nodes.expected_output: The complete modified `_compute_kernel` method with the new branch for FpGroup homomorphisms, surjectivity checks, edge case handling, and proper fallback to existing methods.

nodes.title: Provide complete modified Python file
nodes.description: Assemble the complete Python file with the implemented feature. Combine the modified `_compute_kernel` method with all existing code in the file. Ensure all imports remain correct and the file structure is preserved. The file should be a drop-in replacement that adds the new kernel computation capability for surjective FpGroup homomorphisms while maintaining backward compatibility with existing functionality.
nodes.expected_output: The COMPLETE modified Python file with the feature implemented. Not a fragment. Not just the modified function. The entire file from the first import to the last line.
